exams.name: Insurance Producer Written Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of lines of authority applied for, duties and responsibilities of an insurance producer, and insurance laws and regulations of the state. Individuals previously licensed in another state for the same lines may be exempt.
exams.jurisdiction: state (developed and conducted under title XXXVII and rules adopted by the commissioner; commissioner may contract with outside testing service)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to RSA 402-J:9. The examination shall test the knowledge of the individual concerning the lines of authority for which application is made, the duties and responsibilities of an insurance producer and the insurance laws and regulations of this state.

interval_years.quote: Every 2 years, at least 60 days prior to the renewal date of their license, persons holding a producers license shall be certified by the insurance department as having completed 24 hours of continuing education instruction.

available.quote: The commissioner shall waive any requirements for a nonresident license applicant with a valid license from his or her home state except the requirements imposed by RSA 402-J:8, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must have a valid license from their home state; home state must award nonresident licenses to NH residents on the same basis (reciprocity). Applicant must submit proper request for licensure, pay fees, and provide application or uniform application. Commissioner may verify licensing status through NAIC producer database.
requirements.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to RSA 402-J:12, a nonresident shall receive a nonresident producer license if: (a) The person is currently licensed as a resident and in good standing in his or her home state. (b) The person has submitted the proper request for licensure and has paid the fees required by RSA 400-A:29.

definition_quote.value: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurance company. "Solicit" means attempting to sell insurance or asking or urging a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular company. "Negotiate" means the act of conferring directly with or offering advice directly to a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance concerning any of the substantive benefits, terms, or conditions of such contract

value: Variable life and variable annuity products
Any other line of insurance permitted under state law or rules
lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in one or more of the following lines of authority: (a) Life ... (b) Accident and health or sickness ... (c) Property ... (d) Casualty ... (e) Variable life and variable annuity products ... (f) Personal lines property and casualty ... (g) Credit-limited line credit insurance. (h) Any other line of insurance permitted under state law or rules.

resident_license_available.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner on the uniform application

nonresident_license_available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to RSA 402-J:12, a nonresident shall receive a nonresident producer license if:

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer is required to obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated a licensed producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules, and regulations of this state.

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed 180 days without requiring an examination if the commissioner deems that the temporary license is necessary for the servicing of an insurance business

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed 180 days without requiring an examination

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed agent of that insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Fee set forth in RSA 400-A:29, paid by the insurer for each producer appointed
appointment_fee.quote: An insurer shall pay an appointment fee, in the amount and method of payment set forth in RSA 400-A:29 for each insurance producer appointed by the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of the insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, contract or other insurance business relationship with a producer shall notify the commissioner within 15 days following the effective date of the termination

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: A producer shall report to the commissioner any administrative action taken against the producer in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in this state within 30 days of the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner may verify the producer's licensing status through the producer database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners, its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this state shall make application within 90 days of establishing legal residence to become a resident licensee pursuant to RSA 402-J:6.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An individual insurance producer who allows his or her license to lapse may, within 24 months from the due date of the renewal fee, reinstate the same license without the necessity of passing a written examination.
